title: Belgian air force commander says UFOs are real
summary: Charlie Foltz tells of Belgian air force commander says UFOs are real, about decades ago at Belgium, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the uh supreme air force commander of the Belgian uh military

plain: A guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, Charlie Foltz, says that the top commander of the Belgian air force once stated that UFOs are real. He tells it as support for his own story, since a senior military officer saying so would carry real weight if true.
